articles.title: All Eggs - Steal An Egg [Roblox] Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Every pet hatches from an egg in Steal an Egg, and they come from specific ones that you can find in each biome or buy from the shop. They have a unique design
articles.body:
Every pet hatches from an egg in Steal an Egg , and they come from specific ones that you can find in each biome or buy from the shop. They have a unique design to them that makes them stand out. As you play the game more frequently, these designs will begin to stand out to you, making it easier to identify what pet you're going to get well before you hatch the egg. Here, we'll be listing out all eggs and what pet they hatch into in Steal an Egg.

LATEST UPDATE: All New Eggs Added in the Halloween Dimension Update

For the Halloween Dimension update, released on Oct. 17 , a total of 35 new pets were added. All 35 were added in the Limited section new pets are available in the Limited section, with 12 as in-game shop purchases for Robux, and the rest as eggs you can steal.

The big reveal event occurred on Oct. 31 surrounding the Jonas Brothers making an appearance for the community, for their Burning Up Tour. Although no new eggs were added, a limited time exclusive pet mount, the Burnin' Shell, dropped that players could purchase for 999 Robux. The mount is available until Nov. 2, at 12 AM .

These are the eggs that appear as rewards from the Halloween Dimension. You'll need to visit the Halloween Dimension to secure the eggs, bringing them back to the village and then hatch them at home.

These are the eggs that you can get by spending Robux in the in-game store.

Following the update on Oct. 24, all players can now unlock the Abandoned Manor. To do this, they need to complete Echo's quest, and unlock the fishing rod to get the Phantom Train pass. From there, head into the secret fishing spot in the back, and fall into it. This takes them to a lower area, where they can speak with the previous Manor keeper who lost the key in the water. Make sure to speak with the Manor keeper to learn about the key before fishing. From there, use the fishing rod on the water, and eventually you'll fish the Manor key out. Bring it back to the Halloween Dimension map, and use it on the manor entrance to unlock it.

On the second floor, players can offer two Ghost Fish and Two Voidseer Pumpkins to fuse these pets together. Players can work together to complete this part!

We'll be breaking down these eggs for each biome , which are protected by a specific Guardian for that area. You'll need to outrun the guardian if you want to bring that egg to the safe zone and store it inside your pen to hatch into one of the many pets you can acquire in Steal an Egg.

These are all of the eggs from the Forest Biome. They hatch from the Chicken Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Lake Biome. They hatch from the Swan Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Desert Biome. They hatch from the Scorpion Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Jungle Biome. They hatch from the Tiger Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Snow Biome. They hatch from the Yeti Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Volcano Biome. They hatch from the Cerberus Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Abyss Ocean. These hatch from the Beluga Whale Guardian.

These are all of the eggs from the Prehistoric Biome. These hatch from the TRex Guardian.

These are all of the Cosmic eggs. These hatch from the Cosmic Skeleton King Guardian.

These are all of the Cherry Blossom eggs. These hatch from the Oni Tiger Guardian.

These are all of the Titan Temple eggs, and they hatch from the Gorilla King Guardian.

Monster Eggs are an exclusive egg you can buy from the in-game Robux store in Steal an Egg. There's a chance to get one of 12 different kinds of pets from them, with a low chance of getting a Mecha version.

For these eggs, it costs 99 Robux to buy one, 249 Robux to get three, 799 Robux to get 10, or 3,499 Robux to buy 50 Monster Eggs from the in-game store.

Void Eggs are a series of limited eggs you can acquire through the Rift. The you can receive Void Eggs based on the available banner (which switches out every three hours), and you need must sacrifice three specific pets to unlock the egg.

You'll see the pets displayed by interacting with the Rift to know which you have to give to the portal to sacrifice for the egg.

Angel Eggs appear in the Angels and Demons biome. There's a chance for this area to be for Angels, Demons, or a mix of the two to provide both eggs, with an increased chance for rarer spawns. You want to be at least 20 billion speed to escape this area with one of these eggs.

Demon Eggs appear in the Angels and Demons biome. There's a chance for this area to be for Angels, Demons, or a mix of the two to provide both eggs, with an increased chance for rarer spawns. You want to be at least 20 billion speed to escape this area with one of these eggs.

Luminous Eggs are an exclusive egg you can buy from the in-game Robux store in Steal an Egg. There's a chance to get one of 12 different kinds of pets from them, with a low chance of getting a Luminous version.

For these eggs, it costs 99 Robux to buy one, 249 Robux to get three, 799 Robux to get 10, or 3,499 Robux to buy 50 Luminous Eggs from the in-game store.

Dr. Scramble's Experiments is a limited-time event where you have to destroy multiple drones that appear on the map every 30 minutes. You'll receive vials after defeating them, which you can use to purchase items, namely two eggs: Experiment #001 and Nibbles.

Dr. Scramble's Laboratory is a limited-time event, similar to the Void Eggs. Here, you'll be able to submit three different eggs to get an egg of the current banner, which has a chance to give you one of five different pets. The pets that you can get appear on the right side, under the Experimental Pet Chances tab.

These are all of the pets that you have a chance to get during this event.

Extinction Eggs are an exclusive egg you can buy from the in-game Robux store in Steal an Egg. There's a chance to get one of 12 different kinds of pets from them, with a low chance of getting a Skeletal version.

For these eggs, it costs 99 Robux to buy one, 249 Robux to get three, 799 Robux to get 10, or 3,499 Robux to buy 50 Extinction Eggs from the in-game store.

These are the eggs that appear as rewards for the Racing Event. You can get them for securing wins in the race against other players.

articles.title: Walkthrough - Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse at IGN: walkthroughs, items, maps, video tips, and strategies
articles.body:
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse takes you through a dangerous and heroic adventure featuring Rose Belmont, the daughter of Trevor Belmont. She and her father make their way to a monster-ridden Paris as they uncover the mystery of why these horrific creatures are attacking the citizens and gathering souls.

In this Walkthrough, we'll be guiding you through the many major sections of Belmont's Curse. We'll be highlighting multiple routes you can take, pointing out collectibles you can pick up along your way, and providing in-depth information surrounding the major bosses you'll encounter as you explore this harrowing mystery with Rose. Before we get to the walkthrough, here's a simple description of the Metroidvania structure of the Belmont's Curse, with what you unlock and where to go next.

We'll be dividing up this walkthrough by the sections and bosses you'll be facing off against to progress the story. The bosses are the significant checkpoints that you need to complete to go further into the game and face off against the last adversary in your adventure.

Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Walkthrough Sections

Paris Streets - The Fallen - When you first step off the boat with Trevor, Rose will be exploring the Paris Streets and making her way toward her first adversary: The Fallen.

The Prison Tower - Finding The Warrior - With The Fallen handled, Rose sets her sights on the two other guardians attacking Paris. The first has been locked away in the Prison Tower, known only as The Warrior.

Holy Innocents' Cemetery - Finding the Prophetess - With The Warrior defeated, it's time to make your way toward the cemetery, where Rose will be facing off against an old foe the Belmont family has dealt with once before.

Catacombs of Paris - With the Guardians defeated, adventure further into the Catacombs of Paris, where the mystery continues to unravel, and Rose walks into a trap.

Clock Tower - Finding the Builder - Now that Dracula has returned, it's up to Rose to defeat him and his many followers. Make your way to the Castle, and explore the Clock Tower to face off against Talos.

Main Hall - Finding the Artist - After Talos has been defeated, return to the Main Hall and learn where the Artist is hiding as he works on capturing the brutal artistry of human suffering.

Up Next: Paris Streets - Finding The Fallen Walkthrough

articles.title: Holy Innocents' Cemetery - Finding The Prophetess Walkthrough - Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Guide - IGN
